objects.definition:
typedef enum {
  PW_STATUS_OK = 0,
  PW_STATUS_CANCELLED = 1,
  PW_STATUS_UNKNOWN = 2,
  PW_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT = 3,
  PW_STATUS_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED = 4,
  PW_STATUS_NOT_FOUND = 5,
  PW_STATUS_ALREADY_EXISTS = 6,
  PW_STATUS_PERMISSION_DENIED = 7,
  PW_STATUS_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED = 8,
  PW_STATUS_FAILED_PRECONDITION = 9,
  PW_STATUS_ABORTED = 10,
  PW_STATUS_OUT_OF_RANGE = 11,
  PW_STATUS_UNIMPLEMENTED = 12,
  PW_STATUS_INTERNAL = 13,
  PW_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE = 14,
  PW_STATUS_DATA_LOSS = 15,
  PW_STATUS_UNAUTHENTICATED = 16,
  PW_STATUS_DO_NOT_USE_RESERVED_FOR_FUTURE_EXPANSION_USE_DEFAULT_IN_SWITCH_INSTEAD_,
} pw_Status;
objects.description: C enum type defining Pigweed status codes for C APIs. Represents canonical Google-style error codes. Used as the underlying code for pw::Status in C++. The valid range is PW_STATUS_OK through PW_STATUS_UNAUTHENTICATED; a long sentinel forces switch-default handling. Lifetime is trivial; pass and return by value. String form available via pw_StatusString. Macro PW_STATUS_LAST aliases the highest valid code.

C++ thin wrapper around pw_Status providing convenience constructors, predicates, and string conversion. Default-constructs to OK. Implicitly convertible to/from pw_Status via constructors and returning enum values in the static factories. Trivially copyable; use by value. No ownership semantics. Use OkStatus() to construct an OK status. Note: class is marked _PW_STATUS_NO_DISCARD depending on config macro expansion.

A compact value type that packs a pw::Status code and a size into a single size_t word. Useful for APIs that need to return both an operation status and the number of bytes processed. The size is limited to max_size() (all but the top 5 bits of size_t). Provides named constructors for common error codes, accessors, and helper methods to combine results. No dynamic allocation; trivially copyable. Construction: default OK with size 0, from integral size (OK), or from Status and size. Note: relies on pw::Status from pw_status/status.h, which is external to this header.

No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. It only defines preprocessor macros controlling [[nodiscard]] usage. There are no user-defined types to document.

functions.name: pw_StatusString
functions.description: Returns a null-terminated C string describing the provided pw_Status code. Intended for logging and diagnostics; not intended for programmatic comparisons.
requirements: status must be a valid pw_Status enumerator value (0..PW_STATUS_LAST) to ensure a meaningful string is returned
The returned pointer refers to a null-terminated string that must not be modified by the caller
Lifetime/ownership of the returned string is implementation-defined; treat it as read-only and valid for typical immediate use

functions.name: pw_StatusString
functions.description: C++ overload that accepts a pw::Status and returns a null-terminated C string for its status code. This forwards to the C overload by calling status.code().
requirements: status must be a valid pw::Status object
The returned pointer refers to a null-terminated string that must not be modified by the caller
Same lifetime/ownership caveats as the C overload apply

functions.name: pw::Status::Cancelled
functions.description: Factory that creates a Status with code PW_STATUS_CANCELLED, indicating an operation was cancelled (typically by the caller). Use when an operation is intentionally aborted before completion.
requirements: No preconditions; callable at any time
Returned Status is non-OK and equals PW_STATUS_CANCELLED

functions.name: pw::StatusWithSize::StatusWithSize
functions.description: Default constructor. Creates a StatusWithSize with OK status and size 0.

functions.name: pw::StatusWithSize::UpdateAndAdd
functions.description: Updates this object’s status and adds the provided size. If this is OK, adopts new_status_with_size.status(); otherwise retains the existing non-OK status. The resulting size is this->size() + new_status_with_size.size().
requirements: The resulting size (this->size() + new_status_with_size.size()) must be less than or equal to pw::StatusWithSize::max_size().

functions.name: pw::StatusWithSize::ZeroIfNotOk
